newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $1.00 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, compared to Monday's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 54.50-61.75; 700-800 lbs few 55.50-57.50. Small 1 300-400 lbs 43.00-51.00; 400-500 lbs 46.00-50.00. Medium and Large 2 500- 600 lbs 46.00-49.50. Holstein Large 2 500-600 lbs pen 593 lbs 42.50; pen 1077 lbs 38.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 49.00-53.00. Medium and Large 2 500- 600 lbs 40.00-45.00. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 1,504
